svg.title: A shared brand brain for our team and agents
svg.desc: Vision for the Lovable Brand Hub: designers publish from any creative tool to a central source of truth and brand execution layer. Lovable teams and external partners have direct access, with full design-team control and granular permissions for others. Hue is the Creative OS orchestrator: it calls specialized Brand Hub agents and receives a link to an individual asset or a multi-asset playbook. Other agents and tools use the same brand intelligence. The Hub hosts campaigns, playbooks, gallery, guidelines, assets, Makers and specialized agents per brand or sub-brand, with bulk upload and creation, direct editing, exports and sharing. Access is available through Lovable, Web, Slack, MCP and other tools. Project status supplied by Luc: core primitives achieved; agents and sub-agents in progress; roles, permissions and tool integrations next. The diagram describes the target vision, not a claim that planned integrations or permissions already ship.

g.aria-label: One source of truth. A brand factory at scale.
Design team: full control · Others: granular permissions
Bulk upload & creation · Edit · Export · Share
